verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a in Jehová in tik wach' innhej.
k'anab'ajejek he mam he nun. Tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'uhal ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a juntzanh yechel komon Dios, manh he b'opaxk'e k'e'en k'e'en he diosalok. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Ayik tzeyak'an silab' yik he junk'olal wet'ok, tze k'anab'ajej wal icha sleyal, yuj chi' ol in cha t'ayex.
Ha nok' schib'ejal nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', tze chi nok' t'a sk'uhal chi' yet' t'a junxo k'u. Tato ayto nok' skan t'a schab'jial, snhuschajtz'a nok'.
Tato tzato he chi nok' t'a schab'jial chi', chukxo t'a yol in sat, maxtzak in chalaj silab' chi' t'ayex.
Ha mach schi'an nok' t'a schab'jial chi', max tuplaj smul chi' t'a yib'anh, yujto komon ix yutej tastak to wik yaji. Ha jun mach chi', manhxalaj yalan yik t'a he kal.
Ayik tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej t'a he lu'um, manh pilanok tzeyutej he molank'e t'a stitak, manh ex ek' t'anhanh he sik'ank'e ixim jolom trigo skan eyu'uj.

Ayik tze molan sat te' uwa, manh ex meltzaj he say eyil t'a schaelal, manh he sik'k'e sat sk'ajb'anemi. Ha juntzanh chi' kanokab'i, yikxo heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yaji. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh ex elk'anok, manh eyal esal lolonel, manh eyak' musansatil heb' eyetanimail.
Manh he lok in b'i t'a es. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej ichato malaj welk'och t'ayex. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh komonok tzeyixtej heb' eyetanimail, manh he tok'ek' tastak ay t'a heb'. Manh eyala' to hato k'ik'an tze tup sk'u heb' winh he munlajwum smunlaj tiknaik.
Manh he b'aj heb' chakanh, manh eyak'em tas t'a yol sb'e heb' max uji yilani, palta ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh he b'o tas manh tojolok ayik tze b'oan yaj junok lolonel. Manh eyak'och he b'a yet' heb' meb'a', manh eyak'paxoch he b'a yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Te tojolnhej tzeyutej he b'oanel tas yaj heb'.
Manh ex alwok pekal t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab'. Manh he nacha'anh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh junok eyetanimail yik smiljichamok. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Mokab' chichonoch he k'ol t'a junok eyetanimail, palta wach' to tze kacha' tzeyak'an srazón yik wach' max kotkan t'a eyib'anh yet'ok.
Manh he pak he b'a, mokab' chichonnhejoch he k'ol t'a heb' eyetchonhab'. Tze xajanej heb' ay t'a spatik schikin he pat icha tzeyutej he ya ilan he b'a. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

k'anab'ajejek juntzanh in cheknab'il tik. Manh he cha tajnok nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' junokxo nok' nok' ch'ok yinhtilal. Manh he som eyinhat tzeyawej t'a he lu'um. Manh eyak'och k'apak pichul soman sch'alil yet' junokxo makan anh ch'al.

Tato ay junok ix schekab' junok mach ayxo strato yet' junokxo winh winak, palta tato ay junokxo winh smulan yet' ix, tz'ak'ji yowalil t'a heb' schawanhil. Max miljichamlaj heb', yujto mantzak tupji yik tz'el ix t'a libre.
Ha winh smulan yet' ix chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel winh silab'il yuj smul chi' t'a stielxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Smiljicham nok', haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch nok' t'a wichanh, yuj stupchaj smul winh chi'.
Ayik ol ex k'och t'a lum Canaán, ol eyawan masanil makanhil te awb'en te' syak' sat. Oxe' ab'il max eyamlaj junok sat te' chi' yik tze loani, yujto ay yowalil t'a yol in sat.
Haxo t'a schanhil ab'il, masanil sat te' syak' chi', tzeyak' masanil t'ayin ofrendail yuj eyak'an yuj diosal, yujto wik yaj te' sat chi'.
Haxo t'a yo'il ab'il, eyikxo yaj sat te' chi' yik tze lo'o. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej sleyal tik, yelxo wal ol yak' sat te'. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh he chi nok' chib'ej to max el schik'il. Manh eyak'och he b'a he na'anel tas tzuji, manh eyak'paxoch he b'a t'a ajchumal.
Manh setansetanok tz'aj sjoxjiel xil he jolom, manh he joxpaxel xil he sat.
Manh eyak' echnaj he b'a yuj kusk'olal yuj junok chamnak, manh eyak'och yechel junok tas t'a he niwanil. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh eyak' k'ixwelal ix eyisil, tzeyak'anoch ix ajmul ixal t'a stemplo juntzanh komon Dios, yik wach' max ixtaxel sb'eyb'al heb' anima, yik max ixtaxpaxel he chonhab' yuj ajmulal.
Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'uhal ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ayokab' yelk'och in kajnub' t'a yol he sat. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Manh ex b'at he k'anb'ej he b'a t'a heb' ajchum, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yik wach' max eyixtejb'at he b'a. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
K'eanhek linhan t'a yichanh heb' ichamtak anima, niwanokab' yelk'och heb' t'a yol he sat. Ayokab'pax welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh eyixtej junok anima ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.

Xajan tzeyutej heb', ichato eyetchonhab' heb'. Ya'ilejek heb', icha tz'aj eya'ilan he b'a. Tze nakoti to a ex tik najtil ek'nak ex t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yik Egipto. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh eyixtej heb' anima t'a tas tze chonho', tz'akanokab' eyechlab' tzeyak'lab'ej, icha he ch'anh ayik tzeyechtan he lu'um ma juntzanhxo echlab' tze k'ana'.
Ha he libra yet' eyalmul tze k'ana', tz'akanokab'i. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, a in swala'.
Yuj wal chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej in b'eyb'al yet' masanil in cheknab'il tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
